facts.text: Accommodations range from vineyard view rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Call a corner of California wine country your own in exquisite resort accommodations, from vineyard view rooms to luxurious two-bedroom suites with kitchens.

facts.text: The resort grounds cover 36 acres.
facts.excerpt: Explore our 36 acres

facts.text: The Meritage Resort and Spa opened in 2006 and celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026.
facts.excerpt: Throughout 2026, we're celebrating our 20th anniversary by partnering with other Napa Valley icons to give lucky winners unforgettable wine country getaways.

facts.text: Spa Terra is set within a wine cave beneath the vines.
facts.excerpt: Discover a deeper level of wellness beneath the vines at Spa Terra. Nestled within a tranquil wine cave

facts.text: Spa Terra offers a vineyard view adult pool.
facts.excerpt: Vineyard view adult pool

facts.text: Spa guests can begin with a guided yoga class and steam room session, then unwind at the adult pool with lunch and a soak in the hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Begin with a guided yoga class and steam room session before your service. Afterward, unwind at our adult pool sanctuary with lunch and a soak in the hot tub.

facts.text: Wellness classes are held in the vineyard, the Estate Cave or the Motion Studio.
facts.excerpt: Stretch, sweat and center yourself at wellness classes set in our vineyard, Estate Cave or modern Motion Studio.

facts.text: Spa Terra welcomes guests 18 years or older.
facts.excerpt: We welcome guests 18 years or older.

facts.text: One bedroom suites have a living room, kitchen and large patio.
facts.excerpt: Living room, kitchen and large patio

facts.text: Guests can upgrade to a Pure Room with allergen-free amenities.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a rejuvenating stay in a Pure Room featuring allergen-free amenities.

facts.text: There is a family pool with cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Spacious family pool with cabanas

facts.text: No lifeguards are on duty at the family pool, so parents are advised to watch children.
facts.excerpt: No lifeguards are on duty, so parents are advised to watch children.

facts.text: The resort offers a complimentary shuttle to downtown Napa.
facts.excerpt: The Meritage Resort and Spa offers a complimentary shuttle to Downtown Napa.

facts.text: Guests can explore vineyard walking trails, a chicken coop and the Chef's Garden.
facts.excerpt: Vineyard walking trails, chicken coop and Chef's Garden to explore nature

facts.text: The resort has over a dozen on-site restaurants, bars, cafes and tasting rooms, plus a bowling alley.
facts.excerpt: journey through Napa's food and wine repertoire at over a dozen on-site restaurants, bars, cafés, tasting rooms, and even a bowling alley.

facts.text: Wine Tasting at The Village offers on-site tasting rooms by Napa wineries.
facts.excerpt: On-site tasting rooms by Napa wineries

facts.text: During the Merry Meritage holiday season the resort offers ice skating, princess teas and family festivities.
facts.excerpt: Explore the full selection of Merry Meritage events, including ice skating, princess teas, Santa's reading corner and more festive fun for the whole family this holiday season!

facts.text: The Meritage Resort and Spa is a cashless property.
facts.excerpt: The Meritage Resort and Spa operates as a cashless property.

facts.text: Suite accommodations come with full kitchens and sleeper sofas.
facts.excerpt: Suite accommodations with full kitchens and sleeper sofas

facts.text: Spa Terra is named Best Spas for Girlfriend Getaways and one of California's Best Spas.
facts.excerpt: our Napa Valley spa is named Best Spas for Girlfriend Getaways & one of California's Best Spas.

facts.text: Rooms pair modern design with classic wine country views.
facts.excerpt: Modern design frames classic wine country views in accommodations surrounded by an unparalleled collection of on-site amenities.
